visualIdentity: original vibrant modern tropical pixel art; three-quarter-top-down
outlinePolicy: 1-2 native px deep neutral, no outlines on all floor tiles
shadowPolicy: single soft pixel shadow under feet; not painterly drop shadows
antiCopy: No borrowed proprietary sprites, traced game assets, or copyrighted UI icons

biomeMood.REG_BEACH: sunlit sand, turquoise water, worn driftwood
biomeMood.REG_GROVE: bright palm canopy, resin and fruit
biomeMood.REG_FOREST: dense layered dark jungle, visible trails
biomeMood.REG_SWAMP: olive mangrove, stagnant pools, amber dusk
biomeMood.REG_MOUNTAIN: blue slate, exposed quartz, thin fog
biomeMood.REG_SETTLEMENT: decayed timber, oxidized machinery, nature reclaiming buildings
biomeMood.REG_WRECK: rust and torn sails, salt spray
biomeMood.REG_FERTILE: lush farm terraces and fruit trees

dayNight.dusk: warm orange horizon and cool shadows
dayNight.night: navy color grade; gameplay items remain legible
dayNight.lighting: light sources support campfire, torches, lamps, sky ambient

weather.rain: limited density pixel streaks, puddles, roof shelter
weather.storm: strong wind/cloud shade + lightning, lower FX on weak phones
weather.reducedMotion: optional eliminate decorative motion while preserving state cues

technical.runtimeCache: lazy per group/region; no generated PNGs in v1.9 ZIP
technical.peakTargetDeviceNote: Profile on low/mid-range device; budget is aspirational not verified

visualQA.pixelPerfect: compare snapshots at 1x/2x/3x, no blurred sprites
visualQA.silhouette: player identified at 720p reference canvas and 360px device height
visualQA.layers: occlusion and house roof hide correct
visualQA.style: all original sprites pass common 13-color base palette with accents
visualQA.crossAsset: tool aligns to actual hands in every attack/work animation
